    ServiceWand / Field Service Landing

    Field Service Software
    for Intelligent Field Service Operations

    Field service operations involve far more than assigning jobs to technicians. Modern service businesses coordinate crews, vehicles, routes, customers, contracts, recurring work, emergency requests, mobile teams, billing workflows, reporting, and operational decisions in environments that change throughout the day.

    ServiceWand is field service software built for service businesses that need more than a basic scheduling app. It connects scheduling, dispatching, routing, mobile workforce operations, customer management, billing, reporting, automation, and AI-assisted workflows in one operational platform.

    Whether your business manages seasonal crews, recurring service routes, emergency dispatch, multi-location teams, or complex customer workflows, ServiceWand helps create a connected operating environment for the office, field, and customer experience.

    Features

    Features

    ServiceWand includes the operational features field service businesses need to coordinate work from request to completion, without forcing every team into a rigid workflow. Unlike narrow field service software solutions that handle only one part of the workflow, ServiceWand connects scheduling, dispatching, mobile work, customer history, billing, reporting, and automation in one operational platform.

    Plan jobs, manage appointments, assign technicians, account for route context, and adjust schedules as priorities change.
    Give field teams job context, customer history, notes, photos, signatures, and invoices from a mobile workflow.
    Turn completed work into invoices and operational reporting without re-entering data across systems.
    Assign the right technician, crew, vehicle, or resource to the right job while coordinating route changes, emergency requests, job status updates, and office-to-field communication.
    Keep properties, contacts, service history, contracts, and customer communication connected to the work being performed.

    FAQ

    Frequently asked questions

    G.01

    Field service basics

    What is field service software?
    Field service software helps businesses manage work performed outside the office. It connects scheduling, dispatching, work orders, mobile technicians, customer information, routing, invoicing, payments, reporting, and job status updates in one operational system.
    What does field service management software do?
    Field service management software coordinates the complete service lifecycle: service requests, scheduling, assigning technicians, dispatching crews, tracking work orders, managing customer history, collecting field updates, creating invoices, and reporting on performance.
    G.02

    Platform fit

    What makes good field service software?
    A strong platform balances operational depth with ease of use for field teams. It should include real-time scheduling, dispatching, mobile workflows, customer history, automated communication, invoicing, payments, reporting, integrations, and scalability.
    Can field service software support multiple industries?
    Yes. Many field service industries share the same operational foundation: scheduling, dispatching, routing, mobile work, customer management, billing, reporting, and workforce coordination.

    Build the next layer

    Field service operations are becoming more complex, distributed, and operationally demanding. ServiceWand creates the operational foundation for scalable field service management.
